expected_diagnosis: SSH daemon is inactive; port 22 has no listener.
resolution_guidance: Investigate stop reason; start sshd if authorized.
verification: SSH service active, port listening, login from client succeeds.
escalate_when: Service fails to start or policy forbids guest changes.
production_warning: Không áp dụng lệnh chỉnh sửa trên VPS khách hàng khi chưa có quyền, backup và kế hoạch rollback.
